summary: Tested backend + frontend for /api/bank-analysis/recurring-consolidated feature. All 6 pytest tests passed (GET, refresh, PATCH, DELETE, 404 handling, route-order fix). Frontend /custos-recorrentes page loads correctly with 8 columns, 4 KPIs, category breakdown cards, 5 master rows, inline edit mode with inputs/selects, and functional Recalcular button.
critical_code_review_comments: saveEdit/cancelEdit buttons only have title attributes — consider adding data-testid="save-edit-master" / "cancel-edit-master" for easier automation.
GET /recurring-consolidated returns saved list without recomputing even if underlying analyses changed — user must click Recalcular. This is by design but worth documenting.
fetch() function shadows global fetch — rename to loadMasters for clarity.
seed_data_creation: Used existing 5 seeded masters (Diego, Carlos, TSU, EDP, Vodafone). DELETE test removed the smallest master then refresh restored all 5.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is stable. Route order (/recurring-consolidated before /{analysis_id}) is confirmed working — endpoint returns proper JSON with masters array, not 'Análise não encontrada'.
